get.summary: Check database connectivity and required migration readiness

200.description: Brand image bytes. The content type is the stored image MIME type.

post.description: Returns the committed receipt. A request key replay returns the stored receipt with replayed=true.

201.description: Committed checkout receipt; replayed identifies an idempotent retry.

400.description: Invalid checkout, missing open cash shift (code: cash_shift_required), or PromptPay is not configured (code: promptpay_not_configured).

409.description: The idempotency key was reused with a different checkout (code: idempotency_key_reused), or recipe stock is insufficient (code: insufficient_recipe_stock).

info.title: YELO Coffee Backend API
info.description: Internal API used by the YELO Coffee frontend server.

changeSatang.description: Cash change in satang; zero for PromptPay.

replayed.description: True when the request key replayed the committed receipt; false for a newly committed checkout.
